mcqs.question: Among the following metals, which shows the greatest vigor when reacting with cold water?
mcqs.explanation: Sodium reacts explosively with cold water, producing sodium hydroxide and hydrogen gas. Magnesium reacts slowly, iron reacts very little, and copper does not react. Hence sodium shows the greatest vigor.

mcqs.question: Which of the following metals will NOT react with dilute hydrochloric acid at room temperature?
mcqs.explanation: Copper is below hydrogen in the reactivity series, so it does not displace hydrogen from dilute HCl. Zinc, iron, and magnesium are above hydrogen and react, releasing hydrogen gas.

mcqs.question: When a metal reacts with an acid to produce hydrogen gas, the underlying process is called:
mcqs.explanation: The metal loses electrons (is oxidized) and displaces hydrogen from the acid, a process termed hydrogen displacement. Oxidation is part of it, but the specific term asked is hydrogen displacement.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: According to the reactivity series, which metal can displace copper from copper(II) sulfate solution?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper ions, forming zinc sulfate and depositing copper metal. Silver, gold, and lead are less reactive than copper and cannot displace it.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes the reaction of a highly reactive metal with water from that of a less reactive metal?

options.A: Highly reactive metal reacts slowly, less reactive reacts explosively
options.B: Highly reactive metal reacts vigorously producing hydrogen, less reactive shows little or no reaction
options.D: Less reactive metal produces alkali while highly reactive metal does not

mcqs.answer: Highly reactive metal reacts vigorously producing hydrogen, less reactive shows little or no reaction
mcqs.explanation: Metals like sodium react vigorously with water, releasing hydrogen gas rapidly. Metals such as iron or copper react very slowly or not at all under the same conditions. Option B captures this distinction.

mcqs.question: If a piece of magnesium is placed in dilute sulfuric acid, what observation is expected?
mcqs.explanation: Magnesium reacts with dilute sulfuric acid, producing magnesium sulfate and hydrogen gas, observed as effervescence. No precipitate forms, and chlorine gas is not involved.

mcqs.question: When zinc metal is added to dilute hydrochloric acid, hydrogen gas is evolved. Which metal would produce a larger volume of hydrogen under the same conditions?
mcqs.explanation: Sodium is higher than zinc in the reactivity series and reacts more vigorously with acids, displacing more hydrogen. Iron reacts less vigorously, copper does not react, and lead is less reactive than zinc.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: A strip of iron is immersed in a solution of copper(II) sulfate. Which of the following best predicts the outcome?

options.A: Iron dissolves and copper metal deposits

mcqs.answer: Iron dissolves and copper metal deposits
mcqs.explanation: Iron is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it displaces copper ions from solution, forming iron(II) sulfate and depositing copper metal. Hence option A is correct; the other options contradict the series.
